title: The Club Party
setting: A bright room with many people and colorful decorations.

characters.name: Sara
characters.look: Sara, a young woman with long brown hair and a green dress

characters.name: Ivan
characters.look: Ivan, a tall man with short black hair and a blue shirt

characters.name: Maya
characters.look: Maya, an older lady with silver hair and a yellow scarf

sentences.en: Sara and Ivan go to a club party.
sentences.zh: 萨拉和伊万去参加一个俱乐部聚会。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara, a young woman with long brown hair and a green dress and Ivan, a tall man with short black hair and a blue shirt walk into a bright room with balloons and many people.

sentences.en: The group has members from around the world.
sentences.zh: 这个团体的成员来自世界各地。
sentences.scene_prompt: A crowd of people of many different looks chat and laugh together in the room.

sentences.en: Anyone of any age or nationality can join.
sentences.zh: 任何年龄、任何国籍的人都可以加入。
sentences.scene_prompt: Children, young people and old people of different backgrounds stand together smiling.

sentences.en: Maya is a married lady with a funny husband.
sentences.zh: 玛雅是一位已婚女士，丈夫很风趣。
sentences.scene_prompt: Maya, an older lady with silver hair and a yellow scarf chats warmly with Sara, a young woman with long brown hair and a green dress and Ivan, a tall man with short black hair and a blue shirt.

sentences.en: He is an Australian man who makes everyone laugh.
sentences.zh: 他是澳大利亚人，总能逗大家笑。
sentences.scene_prompt: Maya, an older lady with silver hair and a yellow scarf holds the arm of her laughing husband, a gray-haired man in a suit who tells a joke.

sentences.en: Their adult daughter is at the party too.
sentences.zh: 他们已成年的女儿也在聚会上。
sentences.scene_prompt: Maya, an older lady with silver hair and a yellow scarf waves to her grown-up daughter, a woman of about thirty, across the room.

sentences.en: Sara finds Maya's stories very interesting.
sentences.zh: 萨拉觉得玛雅讲的故事非常有意思。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara, a young woman with long brown hair and a green dress listens with wide, interested eyes while Maya, an older lady with silver hair and a yellow scarf tells a story.

sentences.en: Ivan has a good feeling about the club.
sentences.zh: 伊万对这个俱乐部感觉很好。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ivan, a tall man with short black hair and a blue shirt smiles happily and shakes hands with people at the party.
